Passionate about giving every dog a seat at the table, the company offers vet-developed recipes made with wholesome, human-grade ingredients. The Role
As a Growth Marketing Associate , you’ll play a key role in scaling the company’s paid media and performance creative efforts. Reporting to the Growth Lead, you’ll manage campaigns across Meta, TikTok, influencers, and other growth channels - balancing data-driven strategy with creative experimentation. We offer competitive compensation, opportunities for growth, and the chance to shape the future of a mission-driven pet wellness brand. Apply now and take the next step in your marketing career.

title: Engagement Manager – AI Transformation & Delivery
description:
CAPCO POLAND 

* We are looking for Poland based candidate. 

At Capco Poland, we’re not just another consultancy - we’re the spark behind digital transformation in the financial world. As a global leader in technology and management consulting, we thrive on helping clients tackle the toughest challenges across banking, payments, capital markets, wealth, and asset management.

Lead AI-powered banking innovation from ambition to measurable impact.

The Role

As an Engagement Manager within our AI Delivery Team, you will take overall accountability for the successful delivery of a strategic banking innovation project. You will bring together business, technology and senior stakeholders to turn ambitious ideas into structured, executable outcomes.

You will establish effective governance, shape the use-case methodology and operating model, manage key decisions and maintain a clear delivery roadmap. Working at the intersection of banking, technology and AI, you will help ensure AI-enabled solutions are delivered responsibly, with appropriate human judgement, governance, review and escalation built into the approach.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong delivery leadership, structured thinking and the ability to translate complex programmes into clear recommendations and compelling management-level communications.

What You’ll Do

• Take overall accountability for project delivery, establishing clear governance, delivery disciplines, milestones and ownership across the engagement.

• Lead senior stakeholder engagement and decision management, translating complex topics into clear recommendations and using approved AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve insight, quality and delivery speed.

• Define and embed a structured methodology for identifying, assessing, prioritising and progressing AI use cases from opportunity through to implementation.

• Shape the target operating model and delivery roadmap, ensuring business, technology, governance and organisational considerations are aligned.

• Develop high-quality management presentations that communicate progress, decisions, risks, dependencies and recommendations to senior client stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong experience leading complex transformation, innovation or technology-enabled programmes within banking or financial services.

• Demonstrated experience taking end-to-end accountability for delivery, governance, stakeholder management, roadmaps and senior-level decision-making.

• Demonstrated experience delivering AI-related initiatives, such as AI transformation, Generative AI, Agentic AI or other AI-enabled solutions, preferably within banking or another regulated financial-services environment.

• Ability to structure ambiguous business challenges, develop practical operating models and turn strategic objectives into executable delivery plans.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and create concise, decision-oriented management materials.

• Practical understanding of responsible AI delivery, including the importance of human-in-the-loop judgement, appropriate guardrails, review, auditability and escalation pathways.

Bonus Points For

• Experience developing and applying use-case identification, assessment and prioritisation methodologies.

• Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI principles, risk management or regulatory considerations relevant to financial services.

• Experience designing operating models for innovation, AI or emerging-technology capabilities.

• Curiosity and confidence in experimenting with approved AI tools and automation to improve productivity, insight and delivery quality while maintaining appropriate human oversight.

title: Senior Data Scientist
salary: $250K – $300K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • up to 40% annual performance bonus; paid up to 10% quarterly
description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming - how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands - much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product - not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Demand and sales forecasting - improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series

- Promotion effectiveness - measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay

- Data quality and evaluation - building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

ABOUT YOU

- 5+ years of hands-on data science experience with real-world (not benchmark) data

- Strong statistical foundations: regression, time-series methods, experiment design, uncertainty quantification

- Fluent in Python and SQL; comfortable working in a modern data stack (we use Snowflake and dbt)

- You care whether your analysis is right, not just whether it runs - you validate, sanity-check, and communicate uncertainty

- You can explain a model to a non-technical brand operator and defend it to an ML engineer

BONUS

- Experience with retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand-planning data

- Experience shipping models into production systems (vs. offline analysis only)

- Familiarity with forecasting at scale (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand)

Stack: Python · SQL · Snowflake · dbt · AWS

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

- Carrot Fertility Pro - comprehensive fertility and family-forming support

- 12 weeks of paid parental leave

- Unlimited PTO - plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take

- 401(k) through Vestwell

- Paid relocation support - we’ll help you make the move to NYC

- Fully equipped workspace from day one - laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup

- Team perks - catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

description:
Please read this before submitting your application:

Clover is a nonprofit search firm that partners with nonprofit organizations across the country. Clover team members will conduct the initial review and screening of applications, the Heartland Fund team will conduct formal interviews. We anticipate screening calls to begin in September and formal interviews to take place in October.

• Throughout the search, if you have questions please reach out to Yohanna Briscoe at yohanna [at] .

Senior Operations Associate Job Announcement

Heartland Fund is seeking a Senior Operations Associate. For a thoughtful, mission-driven professional, this position is an exciting opportunity to support new systems and processes in a rapidly growing grantmaking organization and ever changing compliance environment.

Heartland Fund’s Senior Operations Associate plays a central role in keeping our organization running smoothly, weaving together board and governance support, internal communications, leadership team coordination, and day-to-day operational backbone. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactively anticipates needs, and exercises excellent judgment in a fast-paced environment.

You will have an opportunity to help us enable equitable investment in rural communities, democracy, and climate solutions. This is a unique and dynamic position with opportunities for growth and impact as the Heartland Fund prepares to launch as an independent entity in 2027.

This is a remote position within the US. The starting salary range is $75,650 - $89,000. This position includes a generous benefits package.

About the Organization

As a funder collaborative, the Heartland Fund scales investment, supports local leaders, and builds long-term partnerships with rural and Native organizations to create thriving places where rural working people can determine our own futures, strengthening the entire nation. Heartland's grantmaking and programmatic investments support rural people working to transform their lives and communities toward shared prosperity, a healthy climate, and stronger democracy. We invest in building local capacity for issue advocacy, community organizing, economic development and local jobs, climate solutions, civic engagement, and sustainable urban-rural coalitions. We prioritize racial justice in all aspects of our work. In addition to grantmaking, Heartland also supports rural leaders and organizations through convening, research, and communications and storytelling.

Heartland Fund has three programs:

• Rural Democracy expands nonpartisan civic participation and counters policies that harm our democratic institutions in places where rural action can define policy and democratic outcomes.

• Resource Rural (RR) mobilizes resources enabling rural communities to unlock public and private investment to create positive economic change in their communities.

• Rural Climate Partnership (RCP) supports hometowns across America to accelerate climate solutions and build healthy local economies.

Both RR and RCP programs help rural communities access public funding - through place-based technical assistance, local organizing, and a large-scale communications and narrative effort - to make a tangible difference in rural people’s lives and to advance climate mitigation and resilience.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Operations Associate reports to the Senior Director of Finance & Operations and works closely with members of the leadership team to support the Governance and Management functions of the organization. This role is responsible for scheduling, logistics, communications and administrative support for the board, board committees and the leadership team.

Board & Committee Support

• Serve as the primary logistical liaison for the Rural Horizons Fund and Rural Action Funds’ Boards of Directors

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About iSpeedToLead
iSpeedToLead is a two-sided real estate lead marketplace operating across the United States. Sellers of motivated-seller leads list on one side, and real estate investors buy on the other. We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion.
About the role
This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one.
You will own the post-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.
One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.
Key responsibilities
Onboarding and activation

• Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.

• Run onboarding calls and follow-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.

• Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.

Account health and retention

• Manage a book of high-value accounts with regular check-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.

• Build and maintain a health-scoring model that flags at-risk accounts before they churn, not after.

• Run save conversations on at-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.

Escalations and problem-solving

• Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.

• Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.

• Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.

Voice of the customer

• Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.

• Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.

• Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.

Process and reporting

• Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win-back, and escalation.

• Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.

• Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.

Collaboration

• Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.

• Partner with product and analytics on lifecycle experiments and instrumentation.

Requirements

• 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Retention in a high-volume, low-ACV environment such as a marketplace, self-serve SaaS, or transactional product with hundreds of accounts. (Enterprise CSM experience with a handful of large logos is a different job and will not transfer well here.)

• Demonstrated ownership of a retention, churn, or repeat-purchase metric. You can describe what it was, what you changed, and what it became.

• Comfortable working with data: SQL basics or strong BI fluency (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, BigQuery, or similar). You pull your own numbers rather than requesting them.

• Experience building a process from zero, such as an onboarding flow, a save playbook, or a health-score model. Executing someone else's process is not the same thing.

• Confident on the phone with US small-business customers. Our buyers are real

title: Member of Product Staff
description:
About FirstPrinciples

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

 

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

 

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists:

FirstPrinciples is looking for a driven and experienced product manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key, cross-functional role helping shape the vision, development, and growth of our products.

Building at the cutting-edge of AI and science, this role is a rare, rewarding opportunity to build for the unique and complex requirements of the spaces we operate in. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in product management who can combine strategic thinking with enough technical depth to guide our efforts and bring complex ideas to life.

What You’ll Do:

- Define, refine, and shape product capabilities across the Theo Platform products in alignment with FirstPrinciples’ mission.

- Plan, prioritize, and drive product development while balancing technical constraints, product requirements, and strategic objectives.

- Work closely with FirstPrinciples leadership to ensure the product vision addresses research challenges and supports scientific advancement.

- Work closely with technical & engineering teams to translate high-level research concepts into actionable technical specifications and user stories, managing the day-to-day backlog.

- Continuously improve and iterate your product portfolio, deeply owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap of your products.

- Maintain consistent communication across the organization to ensure transparency and alignment.

- Uphold operational excellence through documentation, cross-team alignment, and strong execution rituals.

Who You Are:

title: B2B Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

What you'll be doing

This role is about ownership and execution. You'll take an initiative from brief to launch to optimization: decide how success is measured, pull in the right partners across Sales, Product Marketing, and commercial teams, and keep everything moving to hit the timeline.

Day-to-day in this role, you'll:

• Own paid marketing campaigns end-to-end across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok, as well as programmatic, direct media buys, industry sites, newsletters, and content syndication.

• Work hand in hand with local country Sales teams to understand each market's business goals and shape the best local plan to drive performance at the country level.

• Work with the B2B marketing colleagues to launch new products. You’ll own paid marketing strategy, shaping targets, audiences, campaigns, and key messaging together with Product Marketing and commercial stakeholders, then ramp demand once you're live.

• Manage stakeholder interests and provide ongoing feedback and reporting analysis.

• Work toward clear marketing KPIs, such as CPL, closed-won deals, and revenue.

• Identify top-performing partners and channels and build strong relationships.

• Bring creative ideas to the table and work closely with creatives to produce campaigns that perform.

• Put data at the heart of your decisions: analyze campaign and CRM data to understand what actually drove impact, and build your own reporting and dashboards to keep results clearly in view.

• Use AI actively to work smarter and build AI-powered solutions with the best tools available

• Test new (locally relevant) channels, messaging, and tools, and turn what works into repeatable campaigns

Our humble expectations

• Relevant experience in B2B performance marketing, paid media, or media buying , ideally within a tech, SaaS, or similarly fast-paced environment. We welcome candidates with a range of career paths and backgrounds who can demonstrate the skills and impact needed for the role.

• Hands-on, multi-channel paid media experience across platforms such as Google (Search and Display), Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic media, including managing and scaling campaign budgets.

• International marketing experience , with exposure to working across multiple markets and helping to grow new or emerging products, services, or audiences.

• Demand generation and go-to-market experience , including building campaigns from the ground up and supporting new product launches.

• A data-informed approach to marketing : able to define relevant KPIs (for example, CPL, closed-won opportunities, and revenue), monitor performance, and turn campaign and CRM data into clear recommendations.

• Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets , including tools such as lookups and pivot tables, or equivalent experience with data-analysis tools.

• Strong problem-solving and experimentation skills : able to identify opportunities or challenges, develop hypotheses, run tests, and apply learnings.

• A genuine interest in AI and automation , with examples of using these tools to improve marketing workflows or reduce manual work.

title: Licensed Clinical Psychologist - Intake Specialist
description:
Life at aptihealth

aptihealth is a fast-growing health tech company transforming behavioral healthcare. Our digital platform and affiliated medical group make it easier for people to access high-quality care when and where they need it. You’ll join a mission-driven team that’s curious, collaborative, and passionate about improving lives through technology and care innovation. Here, ideas turn into action and learning happens every day. We’re proud to be named one of the world’s top health tech companies of 2025, recognized for advancing digital behavioral healthcare. Together, we’re building a better, more accessible future for mental health.
Your Role
As a Licensed Clinical Psychologist - Intake Specialist, you will play a crucial role in assessing and guiding patients through the initial stages of their patient journey. You will facilitate a diagnostic interview and incorporate relevant data collected during the evaluation to formulate an initial diagnosis and treatment recommendations. Next, you will pair patients with a Licensed Behavioral Health Specialist who are best qualified to meet the patients' needs. You will use your clinical proficiency, along with the aptihealth platform, to assist our patients in achieving their best possible outcomes.
Be part of a company that is uniquely connecting members with mental health professionals to ultimately impact the lives of millions. If you have a passion for innovation, implementation, and result-driven patient care - join our team!
Requirements

• Licensed Clinical Psychologist in New York State with a PsyD or PhD in Clinical Psychology

• 3+ years’ experience in diagnostic assessment and formulation

• 3+ years’ experience in providing individual therapy

• Experience working with a broad behavioral health population, including anxiety, depression, trauma-related concerns, and other behavioral health conditions, and determining appropriate treatment recommendations and level of care

• Experience working with children and adolescents, including patients as young as age 5

• Experience assessing for crisis situations and suicide or self-harm risk as part of diagnostic or intake assessments

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a compassionate and patient-centered approach

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a virtual clinical team, including coordinating treatment and supporting transitions of care

• Experience using electronic health records, telehealth platforms, and electronic clinical documentation workflows in a remote clinical environment, including completing diagnostic assessments, treatment recommendations, and risk documentation electronically

• Professional proficiency in English

• Some early evening/weekend hours required

• Reliable high-speed internet and access to a private, professional workspace that supports confidential patient conversations and HIPAA-compliant telehealth services

• Experience working within an interdisciplinary or collaborative care model is a plus

• Bilingual or multilingual proficiency is a plus

Benefits

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans available

• Paid Time off, Sick Time and Paid Company Holidays

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with 2% Company matching

• Voluntary Life Insurance

• Employee Assistant Program (EAP)

• Annual business-related expenses stipend

• Competitive salary of 90000-110000 USD/year + Productivity Incentives

• Work from home with flexible working hours

- Content Calendar Ownership: Plan, write, and publish weekly posts on LinkedIn and X. Stay two weeks ahead at all times. No gaps, no scramble.

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one - not a greenfield slide deck.

- You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth - including the journey toward IPO readiness.

- You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

- You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

- Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately - not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

- You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

- Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

- Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

- Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

- Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

- Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

- Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

- Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

- Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

- Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

- A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

- Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We bridge strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

We’re looking for a collaborative, action-oriented Project Manager to join the Total Rewards Strategy and Enablement team. In this role, you’ll lead business-critical People projects, with a primary focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Bringing an acquired business into Stripe requires coordinated work across Total Rewards, People Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.
Core Responsibilities
1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

• Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.

2. Project Management & Visibility

• Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s.

3. Product Rollout Support

• Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model.

4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

• Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.

5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

• Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental.

Who You Are

•
The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).

•
The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.

•
Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.

•
Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.

•
Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

description:

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Claude reaches more people, including individuals, businesses, developers building on our APIs, and the platforms and resellers building on top of those, knowing who is on the other side of a request and what they are allowed to do becomes foundational to running our products responsibly. Creating a centralized identity, verification, and access system that every Claude surface draws on is important to accomplishing our mission.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own the safe access. The primitives are the building blocks the rest of Anthropic uses to manage access to models and capabilities: access programs, accounts, organization linking, verifications, user APIs for platforms, and the internal tooling teams use. You will own the end-to-end product experience and strategy for internal and external access,, across every surface.

This is a role for a strong executor with the ability to be agile in shipping in a 0-1 product space. Safe access is a new product that sits on the critical path of every model launch and every access program. Requirements arrive from many organizations at once, and most weeks you will be the person defining the problem rather than receiving it. 

Key responsibilities

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the account and access primitives, with the goal that any team at Anthropic can provision access or run an access program with minimal support. This is highly ambiguous and requires a lot of cross team coordination and deep understanding of the systems of today. 

• Own the end-to-end experience of getting and managing access for internal stakeholders (research, model launches, safeguards, go-to-market) and for external customers and partners, and keep it consistent across every surface. This requires thinking through many user types, with vastly different experiences. 

• Support the API designs and the UX of the access APIs that platforms, resellers, and internal services integrate with. Work through the designs with engineering and make calls on the primitives yourself.

• Partner with the trusted access and verification product managers so that new programs compose from shared primitives rather than one-off builds.

• Coordinate across the product, safeguards, legal, and go-to-market teams, and drive alignment when their requirements conflict.

Minimum qualifications

• Are a strong executor with a track record of shipping through ambiguity and cross-organization dependencies.

• Write clearly enough that an engineer, an executive, and an external partner can each see the tradeoff you are making.

• Have owned a developer platform, identity, authorization, or access-management product end to end, and were the person accountable for its outcomes (for most people this means five or more years as a PM, but we care about the ownership, not the years).

• Care about Anthropic's mission, and specifically about scaling access to Claude safely.

Preferred qualifications

• 8+ years of product management experience

• Experience with multi-tenant platforms consumed by first-party apps, direct API customers, and third parties building on top

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.
About the Role
Arrowhead Intermediaries is looking for a Data Quality Analyst to join our Data Strategy and Business Intelligence organization. This role sits at the intersection of statistical rigor and data governance: you'll own the quality, integrity, and reliability of the data that powers our reporting, analytics, and downstream machine learning applications. You'll work closely with the Director of Data Products to define what “good data” means for our systems, then build the validation logic, controls, and investigative processes to enforce it.
This is a great fit for someone who thinks like an analyst but cares as much about why the numbers are wrong as what the numbers say , someone comfortable owning a data quality question end to end: framing it, tracing it to root cause, and communicating the fix to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Difficult data quality problems rarely have an off-the-shelf fix. We need someone who can reason from first principles: questioning assumptions about how the data was generated, tracing a discrepancy back to its source system, and building a systematic validation approach.
What You'll Do

• Design and maintain validation rules, reconciliation processes, and quality checks across systems of record

• Investigate data integrity issues, tracing discrepancies between platforms and systems back to root cause

• Build and maintain data pipelines and profiling workflows in Python/R and SQL to support cleaning, structuring, and validation of incoming data

• Partner with data engineering and BI teams to define review and approval controls for data entering reporting and analytics pipelines

• Apply statistical methods (descriptive and inferential) to detect anomalies, quantify data quality issues, and support root cause analysis

• Evaluate the behavior and output of machine learning or scoring models against real-world outcomes, flagging drift or inconsistency

• Translate data quality findings into clear, actionable reporting for non-technical decision-makers and leadership

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define data quality metrics, standards, and reporting cadences across the Data Strategy and Business Intelligence organization

What We're Looking For

• Experience with Python/R and SQL for data profiling, cleaning, and validation

• Familiarity with statistical analysis: hypothesis framing, exploratory data analysis, interpretation of uncertainty

• Exposure to machine learning concepts and an understanding of how model output is evaluated for quality and consistency

• Demonstrated experience designing data validation rules, reconciliation processes, or quality controls across multiple systems of record

• Strong root-cause investigation skills, comfortable tracing data discrepancy from symptom to source

• A systems mindset: able to see how data flows across upstream sources, pipelines, and downstream consumers, and to spot where a fix in one place will surface problems in another

• A first-principles approach to problem-solving: able to break an unfamiliar or ambiguous data quality issue down to its underlying causes rather than relying on standard playbooks

• Comfortable working closely with engineering teams, whether that means partnering on pipeline changes, scoping a fix at its source, or translating a data quality issue into something an engineer can act on

• Visualization and communication skills (Matplotlib, ggplot, and/or Power BI) to make findings accessible to non-technical audiences

• Experience with AI tooling and LLM-based workflows (e.g., Claude, GPT) is important

title: Product Lead, Clinical Decision Support
description:
About Abridge
Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.
Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
Today, Abridge captures the clinical conversation across 300+ health systems and helps clinicians document in real time. Clinical Decision Support (CDS) is the next step: a chat-based assistant clinicians can turn to before, during, and after the visit - to prepare for their day, get evidence-based answers during the visit, and wrap up tasks afterward. It draws on the patient's chart, the medical literature, and the conversation itself, surfacing guidance without interrupting care.
We're hiring a Product Lead to own CDS end to end: strategy, the in-workflow experience, and the content and partnership strategy behind what we surface and when. You'll take CDS from early access to broad adoption across web, mobile, and EHR-embedded surfaces, while driving new capabilities and expansion opportunities. Doing this in a way that earns clinician trust means guidance that's genuinely useful and safe, without adding alert fatigue. You'll work across clinical science, ML, engineering, design, and commercial teams.
What You'll Do

• Own CDS strategy and roadmap. Define the vision, sequencing, and success metrics for CDS - from answering clinicians' questions on demand to proactively surfacing the right evidence. Decide what we build, license, or partner for.

• Own the content and evidence strategy. Partner with Clinical Science on evidence quality and clinical validity, and decide what we surface - across guidelines, journals, and reference sources - and what we won't ship until the quality bar is met.

• Go deep with clinicians. Conduct hands-on user research: shadowing clinicians in exam rooms, observing them interact with our products, understanding the friction they face across specialties and care settings. Turn those insights into product conviction.

• Ship high-quality in-workflow experiences. Partner with engineering, design, and ML to surface guidance that's timely, trustworthy, and easy to act on. Sweat the details of when and how it appears.

• Integrate deeply with EHR environments. Work across Epic and other EHR surfaces so CDS fits seamlessly into existing clinical routines, using chart context (labs, meds, prior notes) to make guidance relevant. Understand the constraints and opportunities of embedded vs. standalone experiences.

• Define metrics and drive outcomes. Establish clear KPIs across adoption, engagement, and clinical quality and safety, and use data to evaluate what's working. Build a culture of measurement and iteration on your team.

• Navigate ambiguity and move fast. Create structure and clarity in areas where the right answer isn't obvious. Form hypotheses, test them quickly, and update your approach when the data says you're wrong.

What You Bring

• Track record of shipping 0 to 1 products and taking them to re

title: Collaboration & IT Solutions Engineer
description:
This is a remote position.
Role Summary
The Collaboration & IT Solutions Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and supporting communication systems for SamaWave and its clients. This includes unified communications, video conferencing, and collaboration tools for Cisco, Avaya, GrandStream and any other potential voice system, ensuring seamless connectivity, security, and performance across all environments in addition to other IT solutions offered by SamaWave Solutions.
This role requires a mix of technical expertise, project management skills, and customer service excellence , with the ability to translate business needs into effective IT solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Collaboration & Unified Communication

• Design, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot VoIP and IP telephony systems (Cisco, Avaya, MS Teams, GrandStream, and similar).

• Integrate collaboration systems with Active Directory and identity management platforms .

• Maintain service uptime and performance for unified communication platforms.

Systems Integration & Support

• Work closely with other teams to ensure seamless system and application integration .

• Participate in IT infrastructure projects , from planning to post-deployment support.

• Provide Level 2/3 technical support for communication-related incidents.

• Analyze system logs, network data, and performance metrics to proactively prevent issues.

• Maintain detailed documentation including network diagrams, configurations, and inventories .

Project Management & Client Engagement

• Assist in developing technical proposals and network design documents for clients.

• Lead or support client implementation projects, ensuring timely and successful delivery.

• Conduct remote site surveys , feasibility assessments, and capacity planning.

• Communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams throughout project lifecycle.

• Provide training and technical handover sessions to clients and end-users.

• Stay updated with emerging technologies in networking, collaboration, and cloud integration.

Requirements
Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, or Information Technology .

• Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Collaboration systems implementation, deployment , management.

• Practical knowledge of Cisco Collaboration Systems, Avaya, 3CX, GrandStream, MS Teams, and others.

• Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, QoS .

• Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP voice or CCIE Collaboration is a plus.

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills in both Arabic and English .

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

Plus skills:

• Provide implementation and support for Cisco cloud networking product ( Meraki ).

• Conduct vulnerability assessments and ensure compliance with security best practices.

• Support cloud networking integrations for Azure, AWS, and hybrid environments.

• Configure and support Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, and Office 365 collaboration tools .

· Other knowledge, Additional Competencies:
- Willingness to upskill as required by the tasks to be performed.
- Good reporting and documentation skills.
- Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Being client service-oriented.
-Previous experience working remotely is preferred

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

• No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

• Typically, clinicians work between Mondays - Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.

title: Dedicated Support Engineer - Toronto
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In this role, you will:

- Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

- Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

- Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.

- Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.

- Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.

- Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.

- Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes
